# The full `TokenUsage` field set, fetched verbatim from
# https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_TokenUsage.html
# (fetched 2026-09-02). `decode.rs`'s `decode_usage` reads `inputTokens`,
# `outputTokens`, and `cacheReadInputTokens`; `totalTokens`,
# `cacheWriteInputTokens`, and `cacheDetails` have no `roundhouse_core::Usage`
# field to carry them and are not read, but are vendored here in full.
cacheDetails
cacheReadInputTokens
cacheWriteInputTokens
inputTokens
outputTokens
totalTokens
